note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Blackfoot River, Hwy 200 ~milepost 35 (east of Bonner); gravel boat ramp for non-motorized boats. Drinking water 5/1-9/30. --Claude
summary: FWP's FishMT page confirms drinking water, a toilet, primitive campsites, gravel ramp, and the $12 (with MT fishing license) / $18 (without) camping fee already recorded. Not stated: site count (12), vehicle length (25 ft), stay limit (7 days), booking (all derived, left). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: No phone: the FishMT page's Contact Information section is empty. FWP Region 2 (Missoula) is (406) 542-5500, the number FWP gives on other Region 2 FAS pages.
max_rig_ft 25 (derived; inclusion evidence cites a camper report) is not stated by FWP: the FishMT page lists no vehicle-length restriction for this site, only 'Primitive Campsite'.
